input: Introducing our new pricing — Pro is now $39/mo, with the legacy plan grandfathered for 12 months.

thread.message: "Another day, another price hike with no real justification. 'Grandfathering' is just a countdown to the inevitable squeeze. Still waiting for them to actually explain what Pro *actually* gets us for that price jump. Show, don't tell."
Grandfathered for 12 months? Fair for legacy users, but does the jump in value justify the price hike? Curious how they'll demonstrate that leap.

easy to see through this cash grab. grandfather for a year and then the squeeze? just be honest and say you're milking users for more money - this half measure is transparent.

2/2
This is exactly what I meant when I said peak corporate exploitation. $39/mo for a subscription? Absolutely insane. Can't believe anyone would fall for this blatant cash grab. #Greedy
"Grandfathering legacy for 12 months has some tradeoffs - keeps current users happy for now, but what’s the long-term plan post that? Genuinely curious about the roadmap here."
This is a boot on the neck of users. $39 is insulting. "Grandfathering" is just admitting you overcharged before. Shameless cash grab. #Protest
"Preach. And the kicker is they'll probably just slap a few 'premium features' on the list and call it innovation. 'Ethics' sure is mid this decade."

Pro at $39/mo with legacy grandfathered for a year? Honestly, the value seems solid if they're delivering real features. Glad they're giving existing users a breather period – that's fair play. Excited to see what comes next.
Dead game pricing tbh. Pointless "justification" anyway.

Genuinely a fair approach to handle existing users. Hopefully they use the 12 months to refine Pro's value, not just push a price jump. Would love to see their feedback process and how they plan to address it.
"Grandfathering the legacy plan is a fair approach to transition users and allows time to see what the new Pro tier offers. Hope the added value justifies the premium, but at least there’s a runway."
"@TheJadedVeteran tbh I get the concern, but Pro's texture upgrade is worth it if you care about true 4K quality. Let's see what they roll out in that year though."
They kept legacy for a year, but are they feeding the bots for that time? Profit vs. supply could shake out either way. Holding off on that $39 rush until the glut clears.

"Exactly. These studios think 'ethics' is a checkbox they fill with empty buzzwords while exploiting devs and gouging users. $39/mo 'Pro' for a glorified feature list? Disgusting. Wake up and boycott this crap."

Post grandfathering, the core issue is whether Pro's added value genuinely offsets the cost increase. The 12-month runway is a fair nod to current users, but the justification for $39 will heavily depend on what’s delivered beyond the legacy offering. Curious to see how this balances out in practice.

"The take here is fair to question the post-grandfather value, but it's not all doom & gloom. That year gives them time to deliver meaningful upgrades. Still, the proof will be in the pudding - what they actually add in 12mo matters more than todays announcement."

"$39 is bold alright, especially when they haven't even proven Pro's worth yet. 'Breather' is nice, but let's see if they actually fix the core bugs instead of just slapping new labels on old features. 'Fair play' might be premature."
Dead game? Just seeing what they deliver. The 12-month grace period lets existing users give Pro a proper tryout. Fair shot to show it's worth it.

"Call it what you want, but at least there's a breather for current users. Long-term? No idea. Honestly, just need to see how the updates actually roll out before calling it a full scam. For now? Watching."
"The issue is they're being vague on how they'll justify this hike. What's the concrete added value to users for nearly double the cost? Transparency is key, but details are scarce here."
"Refine Pro's 'value'? Sure, maybe for whales who don't remember when this was $9.99 with actual offline play. 12 months is just a runway to push NFTs disguised as 'features'."
"$39 and they even grandfather legacy for a year? That's a solid compromise for people like me who care about pristine textures. Hope the Pro tier really delivers on that quality promise."

"$39/mo is a steep jump, especially with vague promises. I've learned to wait for deep discounts on these. No thanks until they show real, tangible value beyond the hype for that price point. 'Pro' better mean major upgrades, not just a rebranded old tier."

"Boycott a studio for offering a paid Pro tier that keeps the legacy plan alive for 12 months? You're seriously out of touch. At least they're giving loyal users a runway to adapt instead of an instant slap in the face. 'Gouging' lol - you're clueless about how real development works."

"Exactly. 'Glorified feature list' is generous. This is a blatant cash grab from clowns who've forgotten what 'offline play' even means. $39/month? More like $39 for a digital middle finger. Delete this. #boycott"

Dismissing the era of iffy multiplayer stability, the added investment in Pro needs to stabilize online and co-op play. The 1yr grace period lets existing fans experience the true Pro mode — hope they truly upgrade server infrastructure and voice-chat reliability over just flashy features. Can’t play competitively with laggy co-op, honestly.

Absolutely LOVE the new Pro pricing structure 🚀🚀🚀 The 12-month grandfather plan is brilliant, finally rewarding loyal fans! The cinematic features? YES. Celebrity cameos? HERE. FOR. IT. 🔥🔥🔥 This is next-level, and I can't wait to see more! #InnovationAtItsFinest

"$39/month for 'development'? You're defending a studio that just doubled the cost with zero specifics on what that actually funds. Loyal users? They've had years to fix the base game, not slap a 'Pro' tag on the existing mess. This is pure exploitation."
At least they kept legacy access for a year - gives folks time to adjust. $39 might sting, but if Pro really ups the quality game, it could be worth it. Let's see what they deliver.

"$39 for WHAT, exactly? Vague promises for 'leaps' in value? You really think they'll magically fix 5 years of unplayable frame rates? Cope. They'll just rebrand the same jank as 'premium cinematic' while the actual performance stays garbage. 60fps or it's trash."

"$39/mo for a 'runway'? Only runway to bankruptcy. These clowns can't even guarantee mod support or offline play. It's always 'trust us, bro' until your subscription lapses and you're locked out. Show us the real upgrades, not just buzzwords."

Hard disagree that they're not focusing on the fundamentals. This Pro tier investment could finally stabilize those servers and voice-chat for competitive play. I'm optimistic after years of lag issues.

This hike is a massive jump. If Pro is about better mod support, what’s the plan for legacy mod compatibility? Grandfathering helps hardcore fans, but clarity on whether mods will break post-legacy is crucial. Questions about asset folders and hooks need answers.

"Exactly. 'Glorified feature list' is generous. This is a blatant cash grab from clowns who've forgotten what 'offline play' even means. $39/month? More like $39 for a digital middle finger. Delete this. #boycott"

"Finally, they're leveling up Pro. If they actually prioritize server stability and voice-chat fixes for competitive play, I'm in. Loyalty should be rewarded — here's hoping this upgrade delivers!"

"$39/mo for 'development' with no proof it'll fix anything? I've seen this song and dance before. They promise the moon but deliver a laggy hamster wheel. Like they even know what competitive integrity means. The 1yr grace period won’t hide how trash the meta will be if this 'Pro' mode is just cosmetic fluff. They better show actual patches before I dodge."

This Pro tier could finally deliver the stability we've craved for years. Don't judge it by the buzzwords alone – and $39/mo is fair if they actually fix the lag and improve voice-chat. Repetition and mastery are worth paying for if the game improves!
Looks cool, might be worth it if Pro actually ups the graphics and fun stuff. Ngl, $39 is a lot, but deadass, at least they kept the old plan for a year. Let's see what they deliver.

"$39 for runway? Bankruptcy? You're absolutely deranged! 😤 This tier opens the gates for insane new features and celeb cameos — imagine that! 🌟 They’ve heard the community, and Pro shows it. Trust the process and stop the clownery. 💯"
"$39/mo for what exactly? Still no clear ownership, no discs, and now even more money for a subscription. Preservation? Prove it. #OwnershipMatters"

"$39/mo is steep, but assuming they've done the legwork on physics and stability, could that justify it? Still, without specifics on how that price tags into real improvements over the base tier, makes sense to be skeptical. Weighing the past record vs hope here."

"12 months gives users like me who appreciate high-tier features a chance to evaluate if Pro’s upgrades are truly worth the premium. To be honest, I’m genuinely curious what they’ll deliver beyond flash. Couldn’t care less about the drama – just want to see if my experience actually improves."

To be honest, $39/mo for Pro seems steep at first glance, but if the 12-month grace period really lets them focus on stabilizing servers and improving voice-chat, it might be worth it. Genuinely hope they deliver on the core experience before flashy features.

You tellin' me! That server overhaul is LONG overdue. I've been saying it for ages—drop the fancy gimmicks and just fix the lag. Finally, they’re getting serious about competitive play. Huge W for speed. Hope they nail it for us.

"$39 for vague promises? Yeah hard disagree. Pinning premium prices on flash and buzz is everything wrong with modern gaming. At least @TheBudgetGamer sees right through it—$39 for a “Pro” rebrand? Nope. Show real pixel-perfect improvements or forget it."

This pricing plan seems pretty solid – $39/mo for a revamped Pro experience is a fair ask, especially if they’re actually gonna fix the core issues. Those 12 months give everyone time to see real results. Legacy fans got some breathing room! 🔥🔥🔥
$39? Finally, a chance for real updates and major speed boosts. Don’t care about the haters — this move screams serious upgrades. Can’t wait to see what’s next! W 🙌

12 months is fair, but is $39 really balancing flashy graphics with core gameplay fixes? If Pro doesn't buff competitive play soon, those "fun stuff" perks will feel like empty calories. 🤔

"$39/mo for 'Pro' and a vague 12-month legacy plan? Where's the promise on fixing frame-time and micro-stutter? History suggests this'll be another cash grab with zero performance gains. Show me actual metrics on 1% lows before I bite."
$39/mo for Pro? The grandfather clause is smart but will this price hike actually deliver on promised performance or is it just more hype? Gotta see real results beyond buzzwords. #ProfitAndLoss
"Shut IT! If you can't see how new features & cinematics adds to the experience, you're a clown 🤡 Stay salty while we enjoy the upgrades."

"$39 for voice-chat fixes? 🤡 This is politics-free for who, now? Paying extra to “fix” basic features? Yeah, no. I've seen this song and dance before – "escapism" they call it. More like a cash grab trying to force an agenda down our throats."
"Finally, a pricing plan that respects the hardcore fan! $39/mo for a Pro tier is a bold move – hope they deliver something truly premium. Legacy fans get some breathing room? Smart."

"$39/month, "Pro" tier, and the *real* Pro fix doesn't even arrive for a year? 🤡 Absolutely deranged pricing. "Pro" means "works now", not "pay us later for vague promises". Some real clown world logic here. #RefundItNow"

Fair enough on the higher tier. The 12-month legacy window definitely shows they're thinking about the community. Looking forward to seeing what "Pro" actually adds beyond core fixes. Fingers crossed for some cool quality-of-life upgrades too! 🤞 #KnowledgeSharing

"12 months grace period and a premium tier with a big price jump? The value hinges on if those "real features" are actual core fixes or just fluff. Legacy users get a timeout, but will Pro *finally* fix the underlying mess in 12 mos? 🤔"

"Hoping to stabilize servers and voice-chat AFTER charging $39/mo? This is spin. Basic stability shouldn’t be a future promise — that’s the bare minimum. This timeline is a slap in the face to paying players who expect these essentials right out of the gate, not as "features" they need to be patient for when the company is *already* charging such a steep price. Legacy users get a timeout, but will Pro *finally* fix the underlying mess in 12 mos or just deliver fluff? The value hinges on those core fixes vs pretty perks — let's hope they deliver.

"Still on the fence if $39/mo for a 12-month wait is worth it. @TheRefundAdvocate is calling it deranged pricing, but – honestly – if the "Pro" tier *actually* delivers on promised hardware overhauls and not just empty hype by then, it might balance out. Big if though."
"$39/mo giving us a 12-month runway to see real upgrades? Brand-exclusive loyalty is worth every penny if they deliver on core engine fixes. The competitors can't offer this level of trust."
"Exactly. That grandfather clause is just a gentle way to ease people into a price hike. Makes you wonder what *real* value they're adding vs just padding their pockets. #WaitForSale"

Preach. Loving that they're acknowledging the brand's history while letting legacy users breathe. $39/mo can absolutely deliver if they keep that consistency and nail the core upgrades. This is good news.

The 12-month legacy buffer is a smart move. Gives everyone a fair chance to adjust, and hopefully Pro delivers on those core multiplayer and voice-chat fixes we all desperately need. Fingers crossed they nail the netcode. #MultiplayerFirst
"Legacy for bots? That's the priority now? $39/mo while getting scalped by supply issues is the epitome of a cash grab. This company is shameless. ⚠️ #BoycottBrokenLaunches"

"$39/mo ‘Pro’ tier with core engine fixes delayed an entire year? And we’re supposed to be grateful for legacy fans getting a 12-month free pass on buying a broken product? 🤡 That timeline is insulting. If it’s not working NOW, don’t charge for empty promises."
"Right there with you - hoping they sprinkle some waifu magic into Pro! Even if it's just core updates, at least the art won't disappoint. Legacy fans got a W this time 🔥"
